violations.text: The chlorine concentration in the sanitizing solution of the 3-bay sink was less than 50 parts per million (ppm). The concentration of chlorine in the sanitizing solution must be between 50-100 ppm. PIC added additional chlorine and retested. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (meat grinder) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. PIC washed/sanitized. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026

BBQ chicken was observed held at 125 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC reheated. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026

Cantaloupe was observed held at 48 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC disposed of. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026

Deli meat, pork, and beans were observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. PIC dated during inspection. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/20/2026

Chlorine sanitizer solution was observed in excess of 200 parts per million (ppm). A chlorine sanitizer solution applied to food contact surfaces must be between 50-100 ppm. PIC emptied slightly, added more water, and retested. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026

Inspector observed packaged cake from another establishment with incomplete labeling (lacking secondary ingredients and complete allergens). PIC relocated cake behind the counter. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026

Inspector observed no staff certified in food safety at the beginning of inspection. There must be an on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. FMC holder arrived during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/20/2026

Dishes and utensils were observed in the hand-washing sink in the service and meat cutting areas. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. PIC removed items. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/20/2026

Soap was not available at the hand-washing sink in the service area. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. PIC replaced soap. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/20/2026

Raw animal foods (such as raw chorizo) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (such as cheese) in the retail cooler. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. PIC relocated raw items. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/20/2026

Per interview of staff, slicer, grinder, band saw are only thoroughly washed, rinsed, and sanitized at the end of the day. The surfaces of equipment that contacts time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods such as meats and cheeses must be washed, rinsed, and sanitized at least every four hours. New Violation. Correct By: 07/20/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (meat grinder) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. PIC washed/sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/20/2026

Pasta, which was prepared in advance, was not cooled to 70 degrees Fahrenheit in 2 hours and then to 41 degrees Fahrenheit within 4 hours. PIC discarded. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/20/2026

Various items were observed held between 78-125 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC placed items in oven for reheating. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/20/2026

Various items were observed held between 48-73 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC placed in cooler for active cooling or disposed based on time/temp. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/20/2026

Ham deli meat and other TCS items were observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 07/20/2026
Inspector observed pasta cooling in walk-in cooler in a container deeper than 4 inches. PIC disposed of item. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/20/2026

Beverages and desserts packaged located in the retail area are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. Establishment moved items from grab & go coolers. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/20/2026

The door to the outside, located in the front, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026

The presence of large flies is not controlled as evidenced by live large flies. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. New Violation. Correct By: 07/20/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the walk-in cooler racks have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 07/20/2026

The walk-in cooler in the meat cutting area is in poor repair (ambient temperature of 48F) The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. PIC called for service and service arrived during inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 07/20/2026

The following was observed in poor repair. - floors in kitchen, meat cutting, and walk-in cooler areas (need resealing) - wall in produce packaging area (peeling paint) - walk-in cooler (need new door gasket)The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 09/30/2026

The floors and walls throughout the facility have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 07/20/2026

Empanadas were observed held at 118-124 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC reheated. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/11/2024
The Person in charge did not assure compliance with critical code requirements. New Violation. Correct By: 06/26/2024
Soap was not available at the hand-washing sink in the meat area. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. New Violation. Correct By: 06/26/2024
The hand-washing sink in the meat area was lacking paper towels. New Violation. Correct By: 06/26/2024
The hand-washing sink in the kitchen and meat area were lacking signage. New Violation. Correct By: 07/10/2024

Raw animal foods were not stored properly to prevent cross-contamination. Except when combined as ingredients, different types of raw animal foods must be separated from each other during storage by using separate equipment or arrranging each type of food in equipment so that cross contamination of one type with another is prevented. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/26/2024
Beef, which was prepared in advance, was not cooled to 70 degrees Fahrenheit in 2 hours and then to 41 degrees Fahrenheit within 4 hours. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/26/2024

Empanadas were observed held at 113-118 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC reheated. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/26/2024

Cut melon was observed held at 60 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/26/2024

Various foods were observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/26/2024
The consumer advisory provided does not disclose the foods on the menu that are raw or undercooked. New Violation. Correct By: 07/10/2024
Plantains were observed held at 99 degrees Farenheit. PIC reheated. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/26/2024

Thermometers are lacking in the prep unit. Cold holding equipment used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must have at least one thermometer that is located to allow easy viewing of the temperature display. New Violation. Correct By: 07/10/2024

Salad packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/26/2024

The presence of insects is not controlled as evidenced by small flying insects in meat area. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. New Violation. Correct By: 07/10/2024
Various foods were observed stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/26/2024
Utensils were observed stored in stagnant water between uses. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/26/2024
Ambient of prep unit was 52 degrees Fahrenheit. Ambient of produce display case was 60 degrees Fahrenheit. PIC called for service, see disposal. New Violation. Correct By: 06/26/2024
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine sanitizing solution for the 3 bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 06/26/2024

The meat area does not have a hand-washing sink that is conveniently located and/or readily accessible. Hand-washing sinks must be located to allow convenient use by employees in food preparation, food dispensing, and ware-washing areas. New Violation. Correct By: 01/05/2024

The floor and wall junctures in the kitchen and meat area do not have coving. The floor and wall junctures must be coved and closed to no larger than 1/32nd of an inch. New Violation. Correct By: 01/11/2024
